title: Pure Raise Moon
summary: The pure Glorious Victors Raise Moon build (TCG 3 December 2026): every Main Deck monster is a Level 7 of a different Attribute, and five of the six Special Summon themselves when you draw them. The deck never searches. It stacks the top of its Deck with Stars of Raise Moon or Raise Moon - The City that Never Sleeps, then draws into its monsters, and makes Rank 7s: Cielo, the Night Sky of Raise Moon - No More Bets! and Squeeze, the Full Moon of Raise Moon - JACKPOT!.

summary.title: Starters
points: Carol, the Elegance of Raise Moon Normal Summons without Tributing and draws 1 card on summon: the deck's most common first Level 7.

Cielo, the Veil of Raise Moon Special Summons itself from the hand by putting another card from your hand or face-up field on the bottom of the Deck, then draws 1 card at Quick-Effect speed in either Main Phase.
Stars of Raise Moon puts any other Raise Moon card from your Deck on top, so the next draw (Carol's, Cielo's, a discard effect's) is the card you picked.

summary.title: Opening: Carol + Stars of Raise Moon
steps: Activate Stars of Raise Moon and put Lapi, the Wings of Raise Moon (going first) or Sharna, the Blade of Raise Moon (going second) on top of your Deck.
Normal Summon Carol without Tributing; her draw takes the card Stars placed, which reveals itself and Special Summons itself.

Going first: Xyz Summon No More Bets! into the Extra Monster Zone, then banish Stars from the GY to draw 1 card, or keep Carol and Lapi on the field so Lapi can Xyz Summon JACKPOT! on your opponent's turn.
Going second: Sharna puts 1 opposing monster on the bottom of the Deck, then JACKPOT! detaches both materials to put 2 more cards there.

summary.title: Draw cards, not searches
summary.text: Cielo, Carol, Lapi, Sharna and Kulshe stop you adding cards from the Deck to your hand for the rest of the turn you use their draw effects, and Squeeze, the New Moon and The Bright Lights do it for the rest of the Duel. So the non-Raise Moon cards are draws: Sacred Sword of Seven Stars banishes a spare Level 7 to draw 2 (the City shuffles face-up banished Raise Moon cards back at the End Phase), and Magical Mallet shuffles dead cards back to redraw. Both are in Glorious Victors. Mulcharmy Fuwalos draws on your opponent's turn, and every Raise Moon monster it draws summons itself.

summary.title: Extra Deck: Rank 7 LIGHT first
points: Carol and Lapi limit you to LIGHT Xyz Monsters from the Extra Deck the turn their draw resolves, and Squeeze, the New Moon's first effect to Rank 7 Xyz Monsters until the end of the next turn. Most of the Extra Deck is therefore Rank 7 LIGHT.
Number 76: Harmonizer Gradielle (reprinted in Glorious Victors) takes on the Attributes of its materials, so two Raise Moon monsters give it two more Attributes to be safe from.

Number C6: Chronomaly Chaos Atlandis (also reprinted) and Exstellarknight Constellar Ptolemy Ω7 use three Level 7s; Ω7 shuffles monsters into the Deck at Quick-Effect speed, which pairs with Lapi's Xyz Summon on your opponent's turn.
Number 11: Big Eye and Mecha Phantom Beast Dracossack are for turns without a LIGHT lock (Cielo with Sharna or Kulshe).

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Searchers (Pot of Prosperity, Triple Tactics Thrust) fight the deck's own restrictions, so the list fills with hand traps only. Upstart Goblin is left out because its opponent gains LP after the draw, so a drawn Raise Moon monster misses the timing to summon itself. Ghost Ogre is excluded to make room for Mulcharmy Fuwalos.

Sharna, the Blade of Raise Moon

Squeeze, the New Moon of Raise Moon

Stars of Raise Moon

The Bright Lights of Raise Moon
Normal Trap: Special Summons a Raise Moon Xyz Monster from the Extra Deck and becomes its material; banishes from the GY to draw.
Sacred Sword of Seven Stars
Banishes a spare Level 7 from hand or field to draw 2.
Magical Mallet
Shuffles dead cards back to draw the same number.
